title: Forward

fields.name: host
fields.description: Target host where Fluent-Bit or Fluentd are listening for Forward messages.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP Port of the target service.

fields.name: time_as_integer
fields.description: Set timestamps in integer format, it enable compatibility mode for Fluentd v0.12 series.

fields.name: upstream
fields.description: If Forward will connect to an Upstream instead of a simple host, this property defines the absolute path for the Upstream configuration file, for more details about this refer to the [Upstream Servers ](/manual/3.2/administration/configuring-fluent-bit/classic-mode/upstream-servers.md)documentation section.

fields.name: unix_path
fields.description: Specify the path to unix socket to send a Forward message.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Overwrite the tag as we transmit.

fields.name: require_ack_response
fields.description: Send "chunk"-option and wait for "ack" response from server.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set to 'gzip' to enable gzip compression.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Forward is the protocol used by Fluentd to route messages between peers.
